contexts.text: The princes and great men of the palace.
If they have been the great men of the kingdom...
When he sees the impious... becoming great men and dignitaries...
Comparatively as with a King, Prince, and Magnate...
Great men () = those who are in goods.
The great men () = the higher ones in their ecclesiastical hierarchy, who are called Cardinals, Bishops, and Primates.
Great men and rich men = internal goods and truths.
The goods and truths which make the spiritual or internal mind, are meant by great men and rich men, the goods by great men, and the truths by rich men.
That great men, in the Word, = internal goods, which are the goods of the internal man, is because great and greatness, in the Word, are predicated of good.
The reason internal goods are signified by great men...
Great men () = those who lead and teach others. AE 644:11.
Great men () = the truths of good.
The great men of Jerusalem () = those who will precede others in teaching truths and goods.
The great men of the earth = those who have transferred into themselves and who exercise this dominion over the Church and Heaven.
